scenes.heading: Freedom and trust
scenes.subheading:
Free people.
Entrust the next real problem.

captionRanges.spoken: Jidoka frees people. Just in time entrusts them.
Together, they can grow freedom and trust.
Jidoka preserves learned judgment and stops known abnormalities.
People are free to think, learn, and improve.
Just in time meets real need.
Only what is needed. When needed. In the amount needed.
In software, entrust the team and AI to respond together.
Give the same people responsibility and authority.
They can decide, collaborate, and stop when needed.
Reduce waiting and unnecessary work.
Keep quality visible in one shared, working product.
The Toyota Way adds two principles.
Respect for People develops independent thinkers.
Through challenge, teamwork, and support.
Continuous Improvement turns each response into learning.
Reduce rework and changeover cost. Make the next useful change easier.
Safeguards free attention. Freedom grows capability.
Capability earns trust. Trust enables the next responsible response.
So look beyond output.
Are teams more freed than constrained by what they've built?
Can we entrust them with the next real problem?
Build the product. Grow the people. Keep learning.
